channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Apple's new CEO unveils foldable iPhone Duo
item.description: John Ternus introduces the iPhone Duo, a passport-style foldable and the most significant iPhone redesign in nearly two decades.

item.title: Anthropic launches interactive model to gauge AI's U.S. economic impact
item.description: A new tool from Anthropic lets users explore whether AI will have a minor or major effect on the U.S. economy through simulations.

item.title: Paris 2024 Olympic balloon makes a comeback two years later
item.description: The glowing balloon-borne Olympic cauldron continues to appear regularly, two years after the Paris Games, as reported from the city.

item.title: Andrew Tate denied bail, remains in custody during extradition case
item.description: Prosecutors noted the Tate brothers' boasts of multiple passports and private jet travel. Their lawyers countered the claims.
